title: Thai-Style Pork Ribs
description: A classic Thai dish featuring tender pork ribs in a sweet and sour sauce. This recipe is perfect for a romantic dinner for two or a fun gathering with friends.

ingredients.name: pork ribs
ingredients.notes: back ribs work best for this dish

ingredients.name: portuguese red wine vinegar
ingredients.notes: or substitute with regular red wine vinegar

ingredients.name: bitter melon
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a sweet and sour mix

ingredients.name: stir-fry oil
ingredients.notes: such as peanut or vegetable oil

ingredients.name: romantic red pepper
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a sweet red pepper

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: optional, but recommended for authentic flavor

instructions: Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and place the ribs on it.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar, brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic, and ginger.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the ribs.
Bake the ribs for 20 minutes, then brush with stir-fry oil and continue baking for another 10 minutes.
While the ribs are baking, stir-fry the bitter melon and dried red pepper in a pan with a little oil until tender.
Add the kaffir lime leaves to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
When the ribs are done, remove them from the oven and brush with the remaining sauce.
Serve the ribs with the stir-fry mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or basil leaves, if desired.
